deals.evidence: is buying the team for $2.275 billion -- the most ever paid for a North American sports franchise
deals.headline: NFL approves David Tepper's $2.275bn purchase of the Panthers
deals.summary: Hedge-fund founder David Tepper bought the Panthers from founder and majority owner Jerry Richardson for $2.275bn, then the most paid for a North American sports franchise; Tepper had to sell his 5% stake in the Pittsburgh Steelers. The sale closed on 9 July 2018.

deals.evidence: the city will pay $650 million toward the renovation of Bank of America Stadium in return for Panthers owner David Tepper keeping the team in Charlotte through 2045
deals.headline: Charlotte approves $800m Bank of America Stadium renovation, city paying $650m
deals.summary: Charlotte City Council voted 7-3 to approve an $800m joint renovation of Bank of America Stadium: the city pays $650m in return for Tepper keeping the team in Charlotte through 2045; Tepper pays the remaining $150m up front and agreed an estimated $421m in potential overages.

ownership_summary: Owned by hedge-fund founder David Tepper (Appaloosa Management), who bought the franchise from founder Jerry Richardson for $2.275bn; the NFL approved the sale on 22 May 2018 and it closed on 9 July 2018. The team sits in Tepper Sports & Entertainment alongside Charlotte FC and Bank of America Stadium. No institutional (fund) minority holder is reported.
